purpose: Evaluate an independent convex primal/dual gap on saved initial and block-corrected solutions; no further fitting or iteration restart.
objective: J(q)=||Bq-y||^2 + q^T R q; B is the full shared-weighted finite-Hann OSC operator; R=alpha D2^T D2+beta I with the ORIGINAL alpha=0.001, beta=0.000001 and scale coordinates.
dual: D(u)=-||u||^2-2 y^T u-(B^T u)^T R^-1(B^T u). Choose u=t(Bq-y), with t minimizing the gap along that dual ray.
identity: J-D=||r-u||^2+||R^(1/2)(q+R^-1 B^T u)||^2, a stable nonnegative sum. J-Jstar<=J-D; both the weighted waveform and penalty distance to the unique regularized mathematical optimum are bounded, not physical identifiability.
